title: 独、買収ルール厳格化へ 安値での提案抑制し株主保護強化

status.text: Germany's draft takeover-law bill would add mandatory-offer thresholds at 35%, 40%, 45% and 50% atop the existing 30% level, targeting low-ball creeping bids; planned effective date is Q1 2027, excluding the ongoing UniCredit-Commerzbank deal.
status.text_ja: 独財務省案は30%に加え35~50%超でも公開買付けを義務付け、忍び寄り買収を抑制する。2027年第1四半期施行予定で、ユニクレディット・コメルツ銀行買収には適用しない。

background.headline: German finance ministry reportedly weighs tougher takeover rules after low-ball bid controversies
background.summary: Reuters reported, via Börsen-Zeitung, that Germany's finance ministry is discussing stricter takeover rules, including tighter disclosure of derivative-based stake-building and a possible second mandatory-offer trigger above the existing 30% threshold, prompted by the UniCredit-Commerzbank and Frasers-Hugo Boss cases; insiders said the governing coalition aims to table a draft bill in 2026, with a Bundestag vote possible in the first half of 2027.
background.summary_ja: ロイター報道(ベルゼン・ツァイトゥング経由)によると、独財務省はユニクレディットのコメルツ銀行買収やフレーザーズのヒューゴボス買収を踏まえ、デリバティブによる株式取得の開示強化や、既存の30%基準に加えた新たな義務的公開買付け基準の導入を検討している。関係者は、与党連合が2026年中の法案提出を目指し、連邦議会での審議は2027年前半になり得ると述べた。

background.headline: Commerzbank chair Weidmann calls for review of German takeover law after UniCredit bid
background.summary: Reuters reported that Commerzbank supervisory board chairman Jens Weidmann said UniCredit had gained control of the bank without paying shareholders an adequate control premium, and suggested that German lawmakers examine the country's takeover law.
background.summary_ja: ロイターによると、コメルツ銀行監査役会会長のヴァイトマン氏は、ユニクレディットが株主に相応の支配権プレミアムを払わずに同行の支配権を得たと述べ、独の立法者に買収法の見直し検討を促した。

background.headline: BaFin's new administrative circular on German takeover law takes effect
background.summary: BaFin's consolidated circular setting out its administrative practice on takeover law, including guidance on minimum-price and offer-consideration rules, took effect on 18 August 2026.
background.summary_ja: 独連邦金融監督庁(BaFin)が買収法に関する行政実務をまとめた新通達(最低価格規定などの指針を含む)を発行し、2026年8月18日に施行した。

background.headline: Frasers Group launches €1.98bn takeover offer for Hugo Boss after passing 30% stake threshold
background.summary: Frasers Group launched a voluntary public takeover offer for the remaining shares of Hugo Boss at €38 per share, valuing the German fashion group's offer at about €1.98 billion, after building its stake past the 30% mandatory-offer threshold partly through put options; Hugo Boss's management board urged shareholders to reject the offer as inadequate.
background.summary_ja: フレーザーズ・グループは、プットオプションの行使などで保有比率を義務的公開買付けの基準である30%超に高めた後、ヒューゴボスの残り株式を対象に1株38ユーロ、総額約19.8億ユーロの公開買付けを実施した。ヒューゴボス経営陣は株主に買収提案の拒否を呼びかけた。

background.headline: UniCredit publishes formal takeover offer for Commerzbank after building 26.8% pre-offer stake
background.summary: UniCredit published a voluntary takeover offer for all shares of Commerzbank on 5 May 2026, after already having built a stake of about 26.8% in the German lender, a structure that critics later said let UniCredit approach control without paying a full control premium.
background.summary_ja: ユニクレディットは、事前に約26.8%の株式を取得したうえで、2026年5月5日にコメルツ銀行の全株式を対象とする公開買付けを発表した。この手法は、支配権プレミアムを十分に払わずに支配に近づいたと後に批判された。

since.headline: Reuters: German draft takeover law would add mandatory-offer thresholds at 35%, 40%, 45% and 50%
since.summary: Reuters reported that a draft bill from Germany's finance ministry would require a renewed mandatory offer when an acquirer's stake crosses 35%, 40%, 45% or 50%, on top of the existing 30% threshold, to curb step-by-step "creeping" stake-building. The reform is planned to take effect in the first quarter of 2027 and, per government sources, would not apply retroactively to UniCredit's Commerzbank bid or Frasers' completed Hugo Boss offer.
since.summary_ja: ロイターの報道によると、独財務省の法案は既存の30%基準に加え、35%・40%・45%・50%を超えるたびに新たな義務的公開買付けを求め、段階的な「忍び寄り」買収を抑制する狙いだ。施行は2027年第1四半期を予定し、政府当局者によれば現行のユニクレディットによるコメルツ銀行買収やフレーザーズによるヒューゴボス買収には適用されないという。
